title: Kappaphycus alvarezii DNA Extraction by CTAB and Precipitation
author: Yasmin Cunha
materials: Use properly sterilized material, as described above.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB extraction buffer (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 10 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), 46.66 mL of 3 M NaCl solution and 4 mL of 0.5 M EDTA; add 2 g CTAB; adjust the volume to 100 mL with distilled water.

steps.title: Add PVP and β‑mercaptoethanol to buffer
steps.instruction: For each 15 mL aliquot of the CTAB buffer, add 0.3 g PVP (to obtain a 2 % final concentration) and 30 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (to obtain a 0.2 % final concentration).

steps.title: Autoclave CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Autoclave the prepared CTAB solution for 20 minutes at 1 atm and 121 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TE high‑salt buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 0.5 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), 16.66 mL of 3 M NaCl solution and 100 µL of 0.5 M EDTA; bring the volume to 50 mL with distilled water.

steps.title: Autoclave TE high‑salt buffer
steps.instruction: Autoclave the 50 mL TE high‑salt solution for 20 minutes at 1 atm and 121 °C.

steps.title: Store algae samples at –80 °C
steps.instruction: If extraction is not immediate, wrap algae pieces in aluminum foil, immerse them in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C until processing.

steps.title: Grind algae in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Place small algae pieces in a crucible, add liquid nitrogen until fully covered, and macerate to a fine powder while continuously replenishing liquid nitrogen to keep the material frozen.

steps.title: First CTAB extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 g of the frozen algae powder to a 50 mL Falcon tube; add 15 mL of the CTAB buffer (containing 2 % PVP and 0.2 % β‑mercaptoethanol) and 15 mL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1); gently invert to homogenize.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at maximum speed (≈5 000 rpm) for 20 minutes at room temperature; transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube and add 1 volume (≈15 mL) of isopropanol.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at –20 °C overnight (or at –80 °C for 1 hour) to allow DNA precipitation.

steps.title: Pellet DNA and ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 20 minutes at room temperature and discard the supernatant; add 5 mL of 80 % ethanol together with 0.08 volume (400 µL) of 7.5 M ammonium acetate, centrifuge 5 000 rpm 20 minutes RT and discard supernatant; add 5 mL of 100 % ethanol, incubate 20 minutes at room temperature, centrifuge 5 000 rpm 20 minutes RT and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in TE high‑salt
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 5 mL of TE high‑salt buffer and incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 hours.

steps.title: Second CTAB extraction
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of CTAB 2× (without PVP and β‑mercaptoethanol) and 5 mL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the suspension; invert gently and centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 20 minutes at room temperature; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube, add 1 volume (≈15 mL) of isopropanol, and incubate at –20 °C overnight (or at –80 °C for 1 hour).

steps.title: Second DNA precipitation and washes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 20 minutes at room temperature and discard the supernatant; add 5 mL of 80 % ethanol with 0.08 volume (400 µL) of 7.5 M ammonium acetate, centrifuge 5 000 rpm 20 minutes RT and discard supernatant; add 5 mL of 100 % ethanol, centrifuge 5 000 rpm 20 minutes RT, discard supernatant and let the pellet dry at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in TE minus NaCl
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in 250 µL of TE buffer lacking NaCl.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 0.25 µL of RNase A to the DNA solution and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using NanoDrop and Qubit; evaluate integrity by electrophoresis on a 0.8 % agarose gel.
